text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear pro-driverless thesis in opening paragraph","quality":"thesis clarity","description":"It states a definite position early and keeps that position visible throughout the essay."},{"evidence":"multiple article-based examples across paragraphs","quality":"use of evidence","description":"It draws on several specific details from the source to support its claims rather than relying on general opinion."},{"evidence":"explains legal liability and state restrictions","quality":"argument development","description":"It develops the case by addressing practical problems and implications instead of only listing benefits."},{"evidence":"mentions safety features like touch sensors, vibrating seats, and cameras","quality":"supporting elaboration","description":"It adds concrete elaboration to show how the technology would work and why it matters."},{"evidence":"organized into introduction, body paragraphs, and conclusion","quality":"organization","description":"It has a clearer overall structure that helps the argument progress logically."},{"evidence":"connects boredom and texting to driver attention","quality":"counterargument awareness","description":"It acknowledges potential objections and explains them, which makes the argument feel more balanced and persuasive."}]}
